description: Stiptheid van IC-relatie per moment is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Maandelijkse stiptheid van IC-relaties per moment bij aankomst op hun eindbestemming. Voor de treinen die door de Brusselse Noord-Zuid verbinding rijden, geldt het eerste station van de verbinding dat zij op hun reisweg aandoen. Een trein wordt als stipt beschouwd als hij met minder dan 6 minuten vertraging in het station aankomt. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Reizigers, Binnenlandse treinen. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
